findings.title: The numbers in the table use a different typeface from the rest of the table

location.description: The Loans and Holds columns of the Most borrowed this month table.

findings.viewer_experience: The viewer sees the digits in the last two columns in a typeface that does not match the titles and authors beside them, which makes the table look put together from two sources.

current.value: The Loans and Holds figures are set in a monospaced face; the title and author columns are set in the page's text face.

findings.target: All columns of the table use the same typeface, with digits that still line up in a column.
findings.fix_direction: Set the table's numbers in the same typeface as its text, and keep the digits aligned.
findings.source: Bringhurst, The Elements of Typographic Style, on consistent type within one table

closed_when.check: Look at the table and check that the numbers and the text beside them are in one typeface.

findings.title: The two small cards have a lot of unused space

location.description: The Returns this month and Holds placed this month cards beside the large chart.

findings.viewer_experience: The viewer sees a short figure and a line of note, then a blank lower half of each card, which looks unfinished.

current.value: Each of the two cards holds a heading, one figure and one line of note in its upper half and nothing in its lower half.

findings.target: The card size fits what the card holds.
findings.fix_direction: Fit the card to its content or use the space for something the viewer needs.

closed_when.check: Look at the two small cards and check that they have no large blank area.
